dedupe_keys.name: labels for emergency response imagery from hurricane barry delta dorian florence ida isaias laura michael sally zeta and tropical storm gordon

description: The coastal-imagery research team publishes human labels for NOAA emergency-response photographs after ten named hurricanes and Tropical Storm Gordon. Zenodo provides CSV label tables and an image archive under CC BY 4.0. Each row identifies an anonymous labeler, flight and image, then marks water-only scenes, developed land, washover deposits, visible built-environment damage, coastal impact and terrain type. These labels can benchmark automated damage mapping and hazard-exposure components in infrastructure-response simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this multi-storm label release. Coverage is the NOAA flights and selected images, not every affected building or a field-verified loss inventory. A limitation is that human visual labels may disagree and aircraft coverage follows response priorities; a missing damage label does not establish no damage. NOAA source imagery and Zenodo annotations have different provenance. No image archive or CSV was downloaded, and inter-rater agreement was not recomputed.
